trans-unit.source: Crazy to think Dhaos has been hiding his castle in a time rift...
trans-unit.target: Crazy to think Dhaos has been hiding his castle in a time rift...

trans-unit.source: If anyone's capable of such a thing, it's him.
trans-unit.target: If anyone's capable of such a thing, it's him.

trans-unit.source: Everyone, please lend me your strength to save this world...and your future.
trans-unit.target: Everyone, please lend me your strength to save this world...and your future.

trans-unit.source: No need to ask. All of us want to put an end to Dhaos.
trans-unit.target: No need to ask. All of us want to put an end to Dhaos.

trans-unit.source: Now, let's get on with it.
trans-unit.target: Now, let's get on with it.

trans-unit.source: Even I'm starting to feel a bit homesick.
trans-unit.target: Even I'm starting to feel a bit homesick.
